title: V9 migration COALESCE guard missing — fails on fresh DB if state_counters row absent
description: SCHEMA_V9 UPDATE chats SET changed_at_counter = (SELECT counter FROM state_counters WHERE type_name = 'chat') with no COALESCE. On a fresh database where no chat state_counter row exists yet, the subquery returns NULL and all rows get changed_at_counter=NULL (violating NOT NULL constraint). Fix: wrap subquery in COALESCE(..., 0).
